        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)

    directions = {
        ("#..", "###"): "down",
        ("###", "#.#", "###", ".#."): "up",
        ("###.", "#.##", "###."): "up",
        (".#", "##"): "up",
        ("##", "#."): "up",
        (".#.", ".#.", "###"): "down",
        ("..###", "..#..", "###.."): "up",
        ("#....", ".###.", ".#.#.", ".###.", "#...#"): "down",
        ("#...#", ".###.", ".#.#.", ".###.", "#...#"): "down",
        ("#..", "#..", "###", "..#", "..#"): "up",
        ("#...", "####", ".#.."): "down",
        (".#.", "#.#", ".#."): "down",
        ("###", ".#.", ".#."): "down",
        ("..#.", "####", "..#.", "..#."): "up",
        (".#..", ".#..", "####", ".#.."): "up",
        (".#..", "####", ".#..", ".#.."): "up",
        (".#", "##"): "up",
    }

    out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    seen = set()

    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue

            comp = {(r, c)}
            seen.add((r, c))
            stack = [(r, c)]
            while stack:
                cr, cc = stack.pop()
                for dr in (-1, 0, 1):
                    for dc in (-1, 0, 1):
                        nr, nc = cr + dr, cc + dc
                        if (0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and
                                (nr, nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc] == color):
                            seen.add((nr, nc))
                            comp.add((nr, nc))
                            stack.append((nr, nc))

            minr = min(rr for rr, _ in comp)
            maxr = max(rr for rr, _ in comp)
            minc = min(cc for _, cc in comp)
            maxc = max(cc for _, cc in comp)
            shape = tuple(
                "".join("#" if (rr, cc) in comp else "."
                        for cc in range(minc, maxc + 1))
                for rr in range(minr, maxr + 1)

            for rr, cc in comp:
                out[rr + shift][cc] = color

    return out
